profile.campus: Chicago metro, Illinois (Equinix Chicago campus, CH1-CH5 and CH7)
profile.address: 1905 Lunt Avenue, Elk Grove Village, IL 60007
profile.reading:
Per Equinix own site, this CH3 facility is located at 1905 Lunt Avenue, Elk Grove Village, IL 60007 and totals 196,151 sq ft (Equinix's disclosed colocation figure). Redundancy: N+1 UPS redundancy, 2 generators (30+ hours autonomy at full load), N+20% Cooling redundancy. No MW power capacity figure is published on Equinix's own building page. The building's original design-build contractor, FCL Builders, describes CH3 as a three-story, pre-cast concrete Tier III facility totaling 379,662 sq ft overall (133,987 sq ft of raised-floor colocation space), rated for 10.8MW at N+1 power redundancy and N+2 cooling redundancy; this larger figure appears to reflect the total building shell versus Equinix's narrower disclosed colocation footprint, and is noted here rather than silently reconciled.

Equinix, the operator, was founded in 1998 by Al Avery and Jay Adelson and has grown into a global colocation and interconnection provider operating more than 260 data centers across over 70 metros worldwide; the company converted to a real estate investment trust (REIT) in 2015. Chicago is positioned by Equinix as the fourth-largest primary data center market in the US and a hub for its financial-services ecosystem, connecting trading firms, exchanges, and technology vendors via Equinix Fabric interconnection, cross-connects, and Equinix Cloud Exchange, alongside cloud on-ramps for AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, and IBM Cloud.

Elk Grove Village, where CH3 sits, has been ranked North America's largest industrial park by Business Facilities Magazine and profiled by the Daily Herald for that distinction, home to more than 3,600 businesses in a suburb adjacent to O'Hare International Airport; that industrial base, combined with proximity to O'Hare's air-cargo and fiber infrastructure, is part of why Equinix and other operators cluster large-footprint buildings like CH3 in this suburb rather than downtown Chicago.

reading.body:
Equinix Chicago CH3 is a 196,151 square foot facility in Elk Grove Village, part of Equinix's six-building Chicago metro campus. The operator publishes no megawatt capacity for this building. Without a published power figure, the facility's scale relative to AI workloads cannot be assessed from available data.

The facility carries N+1 UPS redundancy, two generators with 30+ hours runtime at full load, and N+20% cooling redundancy. These specifications qualify the building for mission-critical colocation workloads. The 30+ hour generator autonomy is notable for resilience but does not indicate power magnitude.

Illinois has 44 mapped data center facilities, of which only 6 publish power capacity totaling 236 MW. Equinix Chicago CH3 does not appear in that published set. Without a megawatt disclosure from Equinix's specification page, this facility's contribution to Illinois's AI infrastructure capacity cannot be ranked or compared to others in the state.
